name: com.velquent/velquent-mcp
title: Velquent Reports
description: Delayed reports on large Hyperliquid open-interest changes and exchange perpetual price moves.

tools.name: latest_reports
tools.description: List the newest published Velquent reports: large price moves on exchange perpetuals and large one-hour open-interest changes on Hyperliquid. Reports appear after a delay. Returns title, coin, type, UTC time, id and link.

tools.name: reports_for_coin
tools.description: List recent published Velquent reports for one coin symbol, newest first. Use the exchange symbol, for example BTC, ETH or 1000PEPE.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Return the text of one published Velquent report by id: summary, technical state, positioning, how the measures lined up, and the hour after. The id comes from latest_reports or reports_for_coin.

report_id.description: Report id such as zro-2026-11-23-1420 or oi-zec-2026-11-23-1505.

tools.name: market_context
tools.description: Count the published Velquent reports in the last N hours (up to the newest published report): how many price moves and open-interest changes, how many rose or fell, and which coins. Covers published reports only.

tools.name: explain_terms
tools.description: Plain definitions of terms used in Velquent reports, such as open interest, funding, long/short account ratio, taker volume and BTC share. Leave term empty to list all.
